name: Mint Infusion
description:
Mint leaves steeped in hot water and strained into a cup. The scent rises readily from the steam without promising any medicinal effect.

One purchase supplies one half-pint cup of prepared drink. The inn retains its serving vessel; takeaway requires your own suitable container. This drink grants no automatic healing or other bonus.
